extracted.name: Ultimate Mac n cheese
extracted.description: I made Mac n chese and I improvised
instruction_lines: After boil in a sauce pan with medium heat add butter till melt
Add shreaded garlic until you smell the fragrance (one minute)
Add the table spoon of all-purpose flour and stir with a fork
Add the macaroni then gradually add milk
Add the powdered cheese and stir till gets creamy
Change to low heat Apply mozzarella or cheddar to the substance till gets cheesy
Add the salt pepper paprika dry mints and chilli powder and stir
Turn off heat and add parsley
